notes:
Company snapshot: Nova Compile Systems builds an enterprise IDE copilot that ships deterministic code snippets as part of reproducible build artifacts. They sell to platform engineering teams at FAANG-adjacent companies; strong focus on auditability and reproducible outputs for compliance.

Primary ask / pain: model/version pinning + reproducibility for code completion. They need a way to pin model binaries and exact runtime config per release so code suggestions are deterministic across developer machines and CI.

Requirements summary (shorthand):
- workload: code completion + multi-file refactor suggestions + docstring generation.
- streaming: low-latency per-token streaming (<50ms target per token in IDE).
- reproducibility: deterministic outputs for pinned model + prompt template + seed/temperature capture. Must support 'immutable pin' semantics for release artifacts.
- rollouts: canary and staged rollouts by workspace/project; automatic rollback on eval gates.
- eval gates: tie to unit/compile tests, lint/regression thresholds, and token-level correctness metrics.
- model preferences: prefer open models that we can quantize; want ability to choose 16-bit or 8-bit profiles per deployment.
- fallback: graceful fallback to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.
- cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictability but want optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.

Security & compliance notes:
- must support SSO (SAML), org-level audit logs, KMS for keys, and data residency for EU customers.
- iso27001 audit in Q1; security review kickoff scheduled.

Timeline & recent activity (crm-style bullets):
- 2024-11-20: Initial inbound via blog; AE outreach (Sofia).
- 2024-11-28: Intro call with product + engineering (Fireflies ff-20241201-8342). Covered use-case, high-level API. "We need reproducible completions for reproducible builds" (quote).
- 2024-12-01: Technical deep-dive with SE (Liam O'Connor). Discussed pin semantics, how to snapshot model+quant, and runtime determinism.
- 2024-12-04: Security questionnaire submitted (drive/security/novacompile-security-answers.docx). Sec team asked for KMS flow and retention window.
- Planned: 2024-12-10 to 2024-12-24 — 2-week POC canary: host dev org on hosted_api with pinned model v2.3, run eval-gate harness (compile, unit tests, lint), measure regression rate and token cost.
- Post-POC: if pass, move to Dedicated for prod (customer wants VPC and optional on-prem bundle for sensitive clients).

POC success criteria (customer-defined):
- zero functional regressions in top-10 critical repos (defined by unit/compile checks).
- no more than 2% drop in suggestion acceptance rate.
- latency SLO: median token arrival <50ms during normal dev flows.
- captured metadata: for each suggestion, record model_id, model_version, quant_profile, temperature, deterministic_seed, and prompt_template_id.

Notes & asks to Redwood:
- Need a clear doc on "pin immutability" (how to freeze a model+config and reference it by id).
- Guidance/runbook for rolling canaries with automated eval gating (example thresholds + rollback policy).
- Example implementation for capturing deterministic metadata per suggestion (schema + storage guidance).
- Pricing scenario for switching from hosted dev POC to Dedicated prod (estimate included in proposal).

Open questions from customer:
- How are random seeds handled across GPUs / quantized runtimes? Need guarantee of bit-level determinism or documented nondeterminism.
- Can Redwood provide a canned eval-suite hook that runs compile + unit tests as an eval gate?
